items.title: Rename the 3 package.json names + cross-deps @lattice-agent -> @lattice
items.context: packages/main/package.json name @lattice-agent/core -> @lattice/core; packages/utils/package.json name @lattice-agent/utils -> @lattice/utils; packages/lab/package.json name @lattice-agent/lab -> @lattice/lab. Update every inter-package dependency entry (utils->@lattice/core, lab->@lattice/core, main->@lattice/lab). Then run a real `npm install` at the repo root so node_modules/@lattice/* workspace symlinks are created (do NOT symlink node_modules in this worktree).
